description: The link where the user orders a design from this chat, with the type, size and quantity set, plus the price for that quantity. Nothing is ordered or charged by this call; the user reviews and pays on patchdesign.ai. Use it when the user wants to buy, get a quote by email, or adjust size and quantity on the site.

designId.description: The design id (d_...) from the result of that design, not its D- number.

quantity.description: How many patches they want. Default: the minimum run for the type.
